messages:
Alex K: Ok team, quick heads-up — prepping for today's weekly KPI review at 4pm PT. Can everyone double-check the cohort dashboard before 3:30?

Samira G: On it. Noticed last week's paid search leads drop in GA4 vs SFDC. Attribution window mismatch maybe? Link: https://redwood.hub/dash/metrics

Devon: /looking. FYI routing change for webinar leads last week — we started mapping utm_campaign -> campaign_name in SFDC. That likely moved ~120 leads into 'Paid Webinar' bucket.

Marta: Can we make sure we use the 'first-touch last-non-direct' window for the KPI summary? Otherwise MQL counts jump.

Samira G: Agreed. Also some landing pages were missing utm_medium on CTAs (see list below).
- /try
- /docs/concepts

Devon: snippet of the filter in our ETL:
```
SELECT lead_id FROM leads WHERE utm_source IS NOT NULL AND utm_medium != 'none' AND created_at >= date_sub(now(), interval 30 day)
```

ops-bot: Dashboard refresh complete — cohorts v2 updated at 2026-03-21T14:45:05Z. CI: 1 failing tile (conversion_rate_by_channel).

Alex K: That failing tile — is it the SQL or the metric definition? We need it fixed pre-review.

Devon: It's metric def. Someone changed the denominator to 'site_visits' instead of 'unique_visitors'. Rolling back and will push a patch.

Marta: Also propose we add a 'webinar-to-demo' funnel for the next report. Last run showed 8% -> want to track drop-off by step.

Samira G: I'll surface the UTM breakdown and a small audit spreadsheet in the thread before 3pm.

Alex K: Great. Action items:
1) Samira — UTM audit and spreadsheet (due 3:00)
2) Devon — revert tile metric and confirm SFDC mapping (due 3:20)
3) Marta — set up webinar-to-demo funnel tile (due COB today)

Devon: ACK. Will DM if any weird edge cases.

Samira G: uploading audit: https://files.redwood/utm-audit-03-21.csv

Marta: Added funnel tile draft to dashboard, preview link: https://redwood.hub/dash/funnels/preview

Alex K: Perfect. If no blockers we'll keep the 4pm cadence. See you then. :thumbsup:

ops-bot: Reminder — weekly-kpi-review start in 1 hour (4:00 PM PT).
